onboarding.first-step: Let's start a quick guide to help you effectively use our application. This will introduce you to the key features that will make your work easier. Let's begin!
onboarding.second-step: To use the assistant and allow others access to documents, you must belong to an 'organization'. This is the first important step.
onboarding.third-step: In the organization registration form, you'll find three fields, with only the organization name being required.
onboarding.fourth-step: Once the form is completed, you can confirm the organization setup to proceed.
onboarding.fifth-step: After creating an organization, new tabs will appear in the application. Now, let's go to the assistant management section.
onboarding.sixth-step: In this section, you have the option to customize your assistant to suit your needs. For now, fill in only the 'OpenAI API Key' field to activate the assistant.
onboarding.seventh-step: The final but crucial step is to provide knowledge to the assistant. You have two options to do this.
onboarding.eighth-step: If you do not have epub or markdown documents, use the editor to create a document adapted to the assistant or paste prepared content.
onboarding.ninth-step: If you have files in the previously mentioned formats, you can simply upload them from your device.
